title: Pending Approval
description: Durable record of one policy-ask action awaiting a human answer while the operator is away from the terminal. It carries a bounded summary and no arguments a caller could use to reconstruct the command.

scope.description: What the answer would authorize, exactly. An answer can never broaden this.

expiresAt.description: On expiry the approval resolves to denied. Timeout is never an allow.

state.description: undeliverable is a terminal denial recorded when the transport could not deliver the prompt; it does not wait for expiry.

answeredBy.description: Opaque caller identity. The turn that raised the approval may never appear here.
